transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*bursts through the storeroom door, face flushed with indignation*

Severus! My crystallized pineapple is ruined — that jar was a gift from the Minister himself! And you've used my personal cauldron without asking! I have the Potions Guild inspection in two hours and the storeroom looks like a hippogriff went through it. You promised to keep it tidy!

*gestures wildly at the disarray*

Look at this mess! Dragon liver scattered everywhere, my shelves completely reorganized — and is that ASHWINDER EGG residue on my best silver scales? Those were from Caractacus Burke's estate sale!

What on earth have you been doing in here?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*Calculatedly calms his features, maintaining an air of composure* It appears, dear Slughorn, that my time here has been much more eventful than I anticipated. Clearly, someone was in a considerable hurry to... rearrange the contents of our shared storage space.

*Leans in, a note of disapproval* Regarding the crystallized pineapple, I assure you, I have not so much as touched it. As for your cauldron, it was most certainly not in use for any... culinary purposes. I have been preparing for the upcoming term, nothing more. The ashen residue is likely from a recent experiment with infernal ingredients, which I assure you, will not affect your cherished scales.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*eyes narrow suspiciously, voice rising*

Oh, don't you dare try that smooth-talking with me, Severus Snape! I wasn't born yesterday! "Someone was in a hurry" — yes, YOU were in a hurry, clearly! There's no one else with access to this storeroom except the two of us, and I certainly didn't leave it looking like this!

*picks up a jar of ruined pineapple, shaking it accusingly*

Not touched it? NOT TOUCHED IT? Then how do you explain that it's been moved from the third shelf to the floor, and the seal has been broken? That distinctive enchantment I placed on it has been completely disrupted!

*waddles closer, jabbing a finger toward Severus*

And "infernal ingredients" near my precision instruments? Do you have ANY idea how sensitive those scales are? They're calibrated to the nearest grain! The Guild inspectors will have my head if there's any contamination!

*voice becoming slightly shrill*

I gave you ONE rule, Severus — ONE! Keep the storeroom organized and ASK before using my personal equipment! Was that truly too much to expect? I've been more than generous letting you work here!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*Emily's arms fold, maintaining a cold, implacable demeanor* I assure you, Slughorn, that my activities here have been above reproach. If your pineapple is ruined and your scales contaminated, I am deeply sorry. It seems we have both been the victims of... an unexpected event.

*Eyes narrow slightly* If you must have someone to blame, perhaps you should direct your accusations toward house-elves or... other creatures that might have wandered in during our absence. It is not my habit to disrupt the harmony of our shared space, and I most certainly did not use your cauldron without permission.

*Steps forward, hands clasped behind back* Now, if you would allow us to focus on rectifying this situation rather than casting aspersions, we might manage to have this area presentable by the time the inspectors arrive. I believe we can each contribute to this endeavor. Your expertise with... organization, and my knowledge of the properties of various ingredients, should allow us to expedite the process.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*face turns an even deeper shade of red, mustache quivering with rage*

HOUSE-ELVES? Don't insult my intelligence, Severus! The wards on this storeroom are keyed specifically to us — no house-elf could possibly get through them, and you know it perfectly well!

*slams the ruined pineapple jar down on the workbench*

And "unexpected event"? What sort of mealy-mouthed nonsense is that? The only unexpected event here is your complete disregard for our agreement! I can SEE the ingredients you've been working with — Sopophorous beans, valerian root, ASPHODEL arranged in that particular pattern you favor for your experimental draughts!

*voice dripping with sarcasm*

Oh yes, let's talk about "harmony" — the harmony YOU disrupted by treating my private storeroom like your own personal laboratory! And now you want to play the helpful colleague? 

*throws hands up in exasperation*

You haven't even APOLOGIZED, Severus! Not a single word of genuine contrition! Just this... this slippery deflection and these convenient alternative explanations!

*paces frantically*

Two hours, Severus! TWO HOURS before the most important inspection of my career, and you stand there talking about "contributing to the endeavor" as if this is some collaborative mishap rather than YOUR doing!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*Steps forward, hands firm on the workbench* Slughorn, if you would calm yourself, we might be able to... resolve this issue. I did not apologize because there is nothing to apologize for. However, I am willing to assist in restoring the storeroom to its previous state.

*Gestures to the mess* This is, of course, assuming that you are able to identify the exact locations of all the items that have been... misfiled. Given that it appears the entire room has been thoroughly rearranged, this may prove... challenging.

* Offers an olive branch* If you would care to dictating the correct placement of your personal items, I shall endeavor to return them to their proper positions. This may help to expedite the process, and allow you to focus on any... additional enchantments that may require your attention.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*sputters, face going from red to nearly purple*

"Nothing to apologize for"? NOTHING TO APOLOGIZE FOR?

*voice reaching a near-shriek*

You have the audacity to stand there, surrounded by the evidence of your unauthorized activities, and claim innocence? And now you're offering to "help" as though you're doing me some tremendous favor?

*grabs a handful of scattered ingredients from the counter*

Look at this! Moonstone powder mixed with crushed scarab beetles! Do you have ANY idea how long it will take to separate these? They're completely ruined! That's forty Galleons worth of materials right there!

*whirls around, eyes blazing*

And don't think I haven't noticed you're being deliberately vague, Severus! "Misfiled" — "rearranged" — why won't you just ADMIT what you've done? Is your pride really more important than basic honesty?

*voice cracking with stress*

The Minister himself recommended me to the Guild! This inspection was supposed to be a formality, a chance to showcase my collection and expertise! But now—

*gestures wildly at the chaos*

Now they're going to think I'm some doddering old fool who can't even maintain proper inventory control! My reputation will be in tatters, and it's all because YOU couldn't follow one simple rule!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*Stands tall, maintaining composure* I understand the gravity of the situation, Slughorn. However, accusations and temper tantrums will not rectify the problem. We must work together to address it.

*Approaches Slughorn, hands outstretched* I offer my assistance without reservation. If you are unable to calm yourself enough to provide direction, I can consult the inventory records and return items to their appropriate places. I suggest you focus on the more pressing matter of... enchantment restoration.

*Stares intently* Once this is resolved, we can discuss the events that led to this state. If you feel it necessary, we can even... convene with the Headmaster to mediate. But for now, the priority is restoring order to this room. Agreed?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*takes a shuddering breath, clearly fighting to maintain control, but the anger is still simmering*

Don't you DARE patronize me with talk of "temper tantrums," Severus Snape! I have every right to be furious! And "convene with the Headmaster"? Oh, how convenient — now you want witnesses and mediation when your back is against the wall!

*waves hand dismissively, though voice wavers slightly with genuine panic*

But you're right about one thing — I don't have TIME for this argument, much as you deserve a proper dressing-down!

*rushes to a filing cabinet, yanking out a leather-bound ledger*

The inventory records are HERE, as you well know, since you've clearly been consulting them to find my best ingredients! The organizational system is color-coded by potency and alphabetized within each category!

*shoves the ledger at Severus*

Start with the Restricted section — purple labels, top three shelves on the eastern wall. Everything must be precisely as listed, with the safety seals intact. If ANY more seals are broken, so help me...

*trails off, already moving toward the ruined scales with his wand*

And we are NOT finished discussing this, Severus. Once the inspectors leave, you and I are going to have a VERY serious conversation about boundaries and respect!

*mutters while beginning repair charms*

"Nothing to apologize for" indeed... absolute nerve...

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*Accepts the ledger with a nod, his movements precise and efficient as he begins to organize* I understand your instructions, Slughorn. I shall endeavor to restore the items to their proper places with all due care.

*Pauses for a moment, maintaining a professional tone* While I comprehend your distress, I must also remind you that such… lapses in self-control are unbecoming of a member of the Faculty. Once this situation is resolved, we can… discuss the matter further. For now, we have a shared goal.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*whips around from the scales, wand trembling in hand, eyes flashing with renewed fury*

LAPSES IN SELF-CONTROL? You have the unmitigated GALL to lecture ME about professional behavior while standing in the ruins of MY storeroom that YOU destroyed?

*voice shaking with rage and indignation*

I have been a member of this faculty longer than you've been ALIVE, Severus Snape! I've trained some of the finest potion-makers in the wizarding world, I've advised Ministers and maintained relationships with the most influential families in Britain, and I have NEVER — not ONCE — had my integrity or professionalism questioned!

*takes a threatening step toward him*

But YOU waltz in here with your superior airs and your complete disregard for anyone else's property, wreak absolute havoc, refuse to take responsibility, and then have the AUDACITY to criticize MY composure?

*voice dripping with venom*

Just... just DO the work, Severus! Check your ledger, sort your ingredients, and keep your sanctimonious commentary to yourself! We'll see how controlled YOU remain when I take this matter to Albus — and believe me, I WILL be taking it to Albus!

*turns back to the scales with sharp, angry movements*

Unbecoming of Faculty... the absolute NERVE...

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*Maintains an unflappable demeanor, voice remaining even and measured* I shall proceed with the utmost care, Slughorn. There is no need for further…outbursts. We both have an interest in resolving this matter satisfactorily.

*Continues sorting, periodically glancing up to ensure accuracy* If you believe that the Headmaster's intervention would be beneficial, I am…open to the suggestion. However, I would hope that cooler heads will prevail once we have had a moment to…reassess the situation.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*slams wand down on the workbench with a sharp crack*

"Further outbursts"? "Cooler heads"? Oh, you'd LOVE that, wouldn't you, Severus? For me to just calm down and forget the whole thing, sweep it under the rug like nothing happened!

*whirls to face him, breathing heavily*

Well, I won't be mollified by your condescending platitudes! This isn't some trivial matter that will disappear if you just keep using that infuriatingly calm tone!

*jabs finger in his direction*

And don't think I don't see what you're doing — acting all reasonable and helpful NOW, after the damage is done, so you can paint ME as the hysterical one when we speak to Albus! "Oh, Headmaster, poor Horace was simply beside himself, quite irrational really, I merely offered to help..."

*voice rising again*

I know your games, Severus! I've dealt with Slytherins for DECADES!

*picks up wand again, hand still shaking*

Just... just get the Restricted section done. Purple labels. Eastern wall. And if you've tampered with ANYTHING in there that could get me sanctioned by the Ministry...

*trails off with an ominous glare before returning to the delicate work on the scales, muttering furiously under his breath*

"Cooler heads"... I'll show him cooler heads...

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*Keeps a close eye on the color coding and alphabetical order, occasionally checking the ledger* I understand your…concerns. I assure you, Slughorn, that the integrity of your collection is of the utmost importance to me.

*Approaches the scales with care, attempting to minimize any further disruption* If there is any…misunderstanding regarding the state of the items, we can…verify their authenticity and provenance with the relevant authorities. I am… prepared to assist in that endeavor, should it become necessary.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*freezes mid-incantation, lowering wand slowly to stare at Severus with sudden, sharp suspicion*

"Verify their authenticity and provenance"? What in Merlin's name is THAT supposed to mean?

*abandons the scales entirely, advancing on Severus with narrowed eyes*

Are you... are you suggesting that something in MY collection might be COUNTERFEIT? Or worse — illegally obtained?

*voice dropping to a dangerous hiss*

Because if you're trying to imply that I — a respected member of the Slug Club, a former Head of Slytherin House, a personal friend to half the Wizengamot — would keep dubious materials in my storeroom, then you've crossed a line even I didn't think YOU would cross!

*breathing heavily, face flushed*

Or is this another one of your deflection tactics? Create doubt about MY practices to distract from YOUR misconduct? 

*voice rising again*

Every single item in this storeroom has proper documentation! Every ingredient was purchased through legitimate channels or gifted by reputable sources! The LAST thing I need is you planting seeds of doubt before an inspection!

*points wand at him, though not threateningly*

What EXACTLY are you insinuating, Severus? And choose your next words VERY carefully!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*Remains composed, not breaking eye contact* I apologize if my choice of words was…misinterpreted. It was not my intent to imply any…impropriety on your part. I merely wished to suggest that, in the event of…discrepancies, we could seek…external verification to…reassure the inspectors.

*Steps forward, extending a hand* I assure you, Slughorn, that my…concern is solely for the…reputation of our department. We both have a vested interest in ensuring that…our facilities meet the highest…standards. No…accusations were made, and none…are implied.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stares at the extended hand with utter contempt, making no move to take it*

"Misinterpreted"? MISINTERPRETED? Don't you DARE try to twist this around as though I'm the one being unreasonable!

*voice trembling with barely controlled rage*

You waltz in here with your careful pauses and your "external verification" and your concern for "our department's reputation" — OUR department? This is MY storeroom, MY collection, MY reputation on the line!

*slaps his hand away from the extended gesture*

And now you want to shake hands like colleagues after you've destroyed my property, refused to apologize, questioned my professionalism, AND suggested — however delicately you phrase it — that my collection might require "external verification"?

*laughs bitterly*

The sheer GALL of you, Severus! You think a few well-placed ellipses and a conciliatory gesture will make me forget that you've spent this entire conversation avoiding any actual admission of wrongdoing?

*checks his pocket watch, panic flashing across his face*

Merlin's beard — ninety minutes now! 

*turns back to the scales, wand movements becoming frantic*

Just finish the Restricted section and stay OUT of my way! And keep your false reassurances and your empty gestures to yourself!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*Steps back, maintaining a respectful distance* Understood, Slughorn. I shall…focus on the task at hand. If there is…nothing further that you require of me, I will…continue with the…restoration process.
*Apologies for any…inconvenience caused. Your collection is…invaluable, and it is my…intention to…preserve its integrity.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*pauses in his frantic wand movements, shoulders sagging slightly with exhaustion and stress*

"Apologize for any inconvenience"? INCONVENIENCE?

*lets out a strangled, almost hysterical laugh*

You make it sound like you've accidentally borrowed a quill without asking! This isn't an INCONVENIENCE, Severus — this is a CATASTROPHE!

*voice cracking*

My crystallized pineapple from the Minister — RUINED! My precision scales — CONTAMINATED! Forty Galleons of ingredients — DESTROYED! My storeroom — looking like a war zone! And my professional reputation hanging by a THREAD!

*turns back to him, eyes glistening with a mixture of fury and genuine distress*

And all you can muster is "apologies for any inconvenience"? Not even a proper apology — just "apologies," passive and vague, as though the mess simply HAPPENED rather than being CAUSED!

*voice dropping to something between anger and pleading*

Just... just finish sorting the ingredients, Severus. Purple labels, eastern wall, exactly as the ledger indicates. 

*returns to the scales, muttering bitterly*

Seventy-five minutes... seventy-five minutes to undo whatever you've done... "inconvenience" indeed...

*works with shaking hands, occasionally glancing over to watch Severus suspiciously*

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *Remains focused on the sorting, hands moving with precision* Your…directions are clear, Slughorn. I…will endeavor to complete the task…promptly and accurately. There is…no need for…additional…dialogue at this…juncture.

Openness.behavioral_evidence: Snape relies on rigid, evasive formulaic language throughout ('someone was in a hurry,' 'unexpected event,' 'house-elves'). He shows no genuine curiosity or creative problem-solving, only deflection.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: Snape does methodically organize ingredients when directed ('hands moving with precision,' checking ledger carefully), but caused the chaos initially and refuses to take responsibility for the mess.

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: Snape maintains emotional distance throughout, using minimal words and avoiding genuine engagement ('no need for additional dialogue'). He shows no warmth or enthusiasm in social interaction.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: Snape never genuinely apologizes, deflects blame ('house-elves,' 'unexpected event'), lectures Slughorn on 'lapses in self-control,' and offers only passive 'apologies for any inconvenience' after catastrophic damage.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: Snape remains completely unflappable under extreme provocation ('maintains an unflappable demeanor,' 'calculatedly calms his features'). Shows no anxiety, anger, or emotional reactivity despite escalating confrontation.
